ns2:section.sectionText: IMPROVISATION, STYLES, AND TECHNIQUES FOR SINGERS. This course provides an opportunity for participants to intimately study the creative process of musical improvisation in singing. Students will examine the language and history of music-making through extensive listening, observation, and research of artists, composers, and songs. A broad spectrum of styles and schools of influence associated with such genre as blues, spirituals, the Great American Songbook, jazz, pop, R & B, rock, and other forms will provide a foundation for exploration. No prior experience is necessary, and the direction of the class will be influenced by the creative elements that individuals bring to the course.
